title: Fixed c: NOT-free lists of fan-in two for a plane's line-ORs right on inputs with w or w + 1 false points, q^2 < 8(w + 1), w + q < N, have at least Nq/c gates
formal_statement: ∃ c : ℕ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ (q N : ℕ) (S : Fin N → Finset (Fin N)), 2 ≤ q → N = q * q + q + 1 → (∀ i : Fin N, (S i).card = q + 1) → (∀ i j : Fin N, i ≠ j → (S i ∩ S j).card = 1) → (∀ a b : Fin N, a ≠ b → ∃ i : Fin N, a ∈ S i ∧ b ∈ S i) → ∀ w : ℕ, q * q < 8 * (w + 1) → w + q < N → ∀ (gates : List PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) (out : Fin N → ℕ), (∀ g ∈ gates, (g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∨ g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or) ∧ g.inputs.length ≤ 2) → (∀ (i : Fin N) (x : Fin N → Bool), ((Finset.univ.filter (fun p : Fin N => x p = false)).card = w ∨ (Finset.univ.filter (fun p : Fin N => x p = false)).card = w + 1) → PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit.eval ⟨gates, out i⟩ (List.ofFn x) = decide (∃ v ∈ S i, x v = true)) → N * q ≤ c * gates.length
plain_statement: There is a positive whole number c such that: for every q at least 2, every projective plane on N = q^2 + q + 1 points (N lines of q + 1 points, two lines meeting in one point, two points on a common line), and every w with q^2 < 8(w + 1) and w + q < N, every list of AND and OR gates, each reading at most two wires, with a wire equal to each line's OR on every input with exactly w or w + 1 false points, has at least N q / c gates.

retired.why: Title named no basis (NOT-free, while GateOp has MOD and MAJ) and omitted q >= 2; refiled with the same term
